name: BraveRats
summary: Two clans each play 8 unique rats simultaneously to win 4 rounds and claim the crown.
rules_text: Each player has 8 cards of one color, each with a strength value 0-7 and a unique mandatory power. Players simultaneously choose one remaining card face-down, then reveal. Normally the higher strength wins the round. Powers override this: e.g., musician, assassin, spy, princess, etc., causing instant win, loss, draw-hold, or changes based on previous round. Winning card stays face-up, losing face-down to track round wins. If strengths tie or a power creates a tie, the round is put on hold; the winner of the next decided round also captures all held rounds. Play rounds until one player has won 4 rounds and wins the game. If all 8 cards are used without 4 wins, the game is a tie.
rating_reason: Two-player simultaneous card duel with powers, bluffing, payoff matrix.
reasons: capability: conditional_subsequence: the step list is flat: a whole BLOCK of steps cannot be chosen instead of another block. This is NOT a limit on conditional scoring or conditional updates: a single step can carry a `when` condition and a single operation an `if`, both arithmetic, so 'the poisoner scores if the choices match, otherwise the chooser' is fine
